en: The image shows a vintage-style postcard featuring a prominent baroque monument with several statues, likely religious, in a public square. There are people gathered around the monument, and a large building with green window shutters and a reddish roof stands in the background. The sky is blue with some clouds. The text at the top reads: 'Pécs. Szentháromszágszobor a főgymnasiummal.'
